critical_findings.citation_heritage_174k_validated: Citation heritage benchmark run on frozen 1020 positive pairs from 174k citation-ID resolution (2,019/2,105 resolved). 3/8 TF-IDF representations PASS (AUC >= 0.65): cited_decisions_tfidf (0.7296), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (0.7027), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (0.7144). 5/8 FAIL: full_text_tfidf_light (0.6147), outcome_tfidf (0.6202), regeste_tfidf (0.4950), regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5 (0.6249), regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.7 (0.6465). Confirms fundamental two-mode tradeoff: citation-based signals recover citation heritage; text-based signals do not.
critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_174k_generaliza: v17b label normalization tested at 174k scale (91,193 decisions with known legal_area, 5,000 sample). Raw labels: 214 unique -> Normalized: 164 unique (23.4% reduction). Purity gains CONFIRMED across all 3 production TF-IDF representations: cited_decisions_tfidf (+36.2%), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (+7.2%), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (+17.3%). NMI decreases in all cases (-0.02 to -0.04). Regime shift at scale: purity improves but NMI degrades because normalization merges labels that embeddings were separating. Consistent with legal-distance finding: 'Different regime at scale — requires separate validation.'
critical_findings.tfidf_174k_formal_suite_complete: TF-IDF family (8 reps) COMPLETE at 174k scale on frozen harness v3. Adversarial gates: all 8 PASS both language_dominance (<0.85) and jurist_pairwise_preference (>0.5). Full-corpus benchmarks: temporal_stability FAIL for citation-based (mean overlap 0.36-0.38), PASS for full_text (0.78); hierarchy_coherence FAIL all (NMI < 0.03); cluster_coherence FAIL all (branch purity ~0.3); cross_language_retrieval FAIL all (recall@10 ~0.14); boilerplate_resistance FAIL all (score ~-0.8). Production default cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 validated.
